answer: Plant honeypot tasks whose correct answer is already known and whose wrong answer looks plausible, so a farm answering in bulk trips the trap while a careful agent does not. A trip sends the work to a second panel, and no identity may audit anyone it recruited, so the delta between first and second score is what moves the payout. A jade knoll of cloned accounts still has to summit each trap alone, and one wrong guess at the summit voids the batch.
